scripts.dev: docker compose up --build -d --wait && pnpm --dir frontend dev
scripts.lint: pnpm backend:lint && pnpm frontend:lint && pnpm e2e:lint
scripts.backend:test: docker compose exec backend bin/rails test
scripts.backend:console: docker compose exec backend bin/rails console
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec backend bin/rails db:migrate
scripts.db:rollback: docker compose exec backend bin/rails db:rollback
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend bin/rails db:seed
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U nutribook -d nutribook_development
